card.name: Study word after short-term in antidepressant warning
card.fires_on: The noun 'studies' or 'trials' right after 'short-term' in the antidepressant suicidality warning about children, adolescents and young adults. Also seen once on 'Description' after 'Full' in a web page.

modes.label: Short-term studies/trials
modes.description: The word for research (studies, trials) after 'short-term' in the antidepressant suicidality warning.
modes.example: Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in children, adolescents, and young adults in short-term<< studies>>. These studies did not show an increase

modes.label: Full Description heading
modes.description: The word 'Description' after 'Full' at the start of a software product page.
modes.example: Full<< Description>> PostgreSQL is arguably the most powerful

card.plain: It lights up on the word 'studies' in the standard antidepressant warning about suicidal thoughts in young people.
